retrieved.title: File share \\fs02\shared inaccessible
retrieved.description: [TCK-57838] Ticket raised because users cannot access the network file share \\fs02\shared; it returns 'network path not found'. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: The share service backing \\fs02\shared had crashed; restarted it, verified permissions, and remapped the share for affected users.

retrieved.title: Permissions incorrect on \\fs02\shared
retrieved.description: [TCK-99679] Ticket raised because several Mumbai HQ users report they can see the folder \\fs02\shared but get 'access denied' when opening files inside it. This is impacting daily work.
retrieved.resolution: Corrected the inherited NTFS permissions on \\fs02\shared for the relevant Mumbai HQ group and re-propagated ACLs so the files opened as expected.
